title: Mixed Event — Unnamed Harmony — Episode7 In Our Grasp

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has decided to try and go pro, and is practicing with more effort than ever. To make their own song to perform at shows, they decide to each come up with different parts to compare. Wanting to be of help to the band, Saki works harder than anyone else on her contribution, but...

rows.Line: Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What thoughts do I want going into this song? What do I want it to convey...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
This is turning out to be really hard too...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (How do the pros do it? They make all these amazing songs AND they look cool on stage...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (STANDOUT made it big because they can do just that.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That's why the crowd always goes so wild for them...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Us too...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We went on that big stage and performed in front of all those people...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It feels like it was all just a dream now. I felt so nervous too after being told that we'd be a part of that show.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But we were desperate to tell Shiho how we all felt then...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We wanted her to stay. We wanted to keep our band together. We did everything we could...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (And we somehow managed to put on a good performance...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (So as long as we truly believe in what we're doing, things will go well for us...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But I haven't been able to reach that point while writing our song...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What sort of thoughts are going into this song...?
The next day - Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho! It's pretty rare for you to come over and visit our class. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's something I'd like to talk about. Is Ichika busy with her committee...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Lately, she's been having to do a lot of stuff for them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did you want to discuss songwriting and stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That too, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why don't we have lunch together since we're gonna chat? On the rooftop, for example.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sure...!
Lunch with Shiho it is! Let's go!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That was delicious!
Whew! I'm stuffed!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The weather's nice too. I'm gonna fall asleep at this rate after eating all that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. A nap does sound pretty good right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but I feel like it's gonna be impossible to wake up if we do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're right!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If only Hona were here, she'd wake us up just before the bell rang!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'd be depending on her too much if we did.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I understand where you're coming from.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You said that you want to play music that can touch people's hearts, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean you want them to feel a certain way or get a message across to them?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Making people feel a certain way...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I didn't help write any of the songs I've been playing until now, so it's hard to say that I'm emotionally invested in them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But when I'm performing, I try to convey whatever thoughts I feel did go into them...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Each song means a certain something to whoever wrote it. I believe my job is to understand and relay those feelings to whoever may be listening...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Understanding and relaying those feelings...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But there's more to it than just that now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have all of you and Leo/need now. The ones who said they all want the same dream to come true...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So now, I want us to be able to convey whatever it is that we can through our performances.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I don't specifically know what that is yet or how we'll do that...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The thing that we can convey...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... What could that possibly be?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've been thinking about that for a while now and still haven't been able to find an answer.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But out of all of us, I think you're gonna be the one to do that first...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What? Me?
Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. Purely because you're always so honest about yourself.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You find the things that you want to do and make sure you'll actually be able to do them, right? You've helped us so much already by doing just that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why I believe you'll be the first one to figure out what kind of feelings we want to convey as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm happy that she's saying this but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Am I really gonna be able to find that answer...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We decided to try and go pro together, but I'm so worried about holding everyone else back...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (What can I possibly...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're already doing plenty, Saki. You're the one who's always there to cheer us up and push us in the right direction...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: These three songs here are among my absolute favorites.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. There was a time when I wasn't feeling too sure about myself, but listening to those songs made me feel so much better.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, is something...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I... I got it...!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Shiho! Thank you! Thank you! I know what I want to convey with my song now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're finally back to your usual self...
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Riiin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?! Sakki, what's the matter? You're not having practice until much later, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I got my answer, Rin! I know what kind of thoughts I want going into my song!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was focusing way too much on wanting to go pro with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was really starting to worry about how I wasn't getting any better or able to help by coming up with our very own song...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sakki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But Shiho told me what I needed to hear!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She said that I'm always honest with myself and have been helping everyone out just by being myself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She even said that I'd be the one that first figures out what sort of feelings or messages we'd want to convey as a band.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's when I realized something.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I decided that I want to try coming up with songs for Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I know it's important to keep in mind how our audience will react since we're trying to go pro...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But while we work towards that goal, I wanna first try writing a song that can cheer everyone up after they listen to it...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehehe...♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That sounds wonderful, Sakki!
You made me feel all warm and fuzzy inside!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Rin...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna hear what you come up with as soon as possible! I'll help you with your song however I can too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? Thank you so much, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then lemme get my synth ready!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what if we made it sound something like this? Hum hum huuum...♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, okay! We can do that and spice up the melody a little by doing this!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! So this part goes like...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Looks like Saki knows what she wants to do now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it does. She and Rin look like they're having quite a bit of fun too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
I'm glad she finally found a way to move forward.
